_about: Corrections to Open Food Facts' truth for the label-reading eval, each checked against the photo itself (by Claude, reading the photo; spot-check before relying on it). `exclude` drops a label from nutrient scoring; `nutrition` and `additives` replace the truth values given. Nutrients a label does not print are handled by the runner (truth 0, read nothing: not scored), so they are not listed here.
